title.zh: 牛顿运动定律 · F = ma 是调出来的
title.en: Newton’s Laws of Motion · F = ma, Tuned by Hand

desc.zh: 在斜面和平地上推箱子：受力箭头与加速度实时对账，F=ma 不是背出来的，是调出来的。
desc.en: Push a box on ice, on a rough floor and on a ramp: the force arrows and the acceleration stay in step, so F = ma is something you tune, not memorise.

legacyLayout._note: Whitespace and markup of the hand-written lesson this page was converted from, so the conversion could be checked byte for byte (specs/site-template.md §3c).
